title: Lemon Tree Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Lemon Tree is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Prime Seaside Location — 3-Minute Walk to the BeachWelcome to Lemon Tree, a professionally decorated 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath vacation home in Seaside, Florida, offering an ideal location just 176 yards from beach access—approximately a 3-minute walk to the Gulf. Sleeping up to 10 guests, Lemon Tree is a popular choice for families and groups looking for a spacious, comfortable Seaside vacation rental within easy walking distance of the beach, Town Square, shops, restaurants, and Seaside's iconic coastal amenities. Located in the heart of Seaside, Lemon Tree puts more than 40 shops and restaurants within easy walking distance, making it possible to enjoy much of your vacation without getting in the car.Comfortable Accommodations for Up to 10 GuestsLemon Tree welcomes guests with a charming front porch overlooking a beautifully landscaped private yard. Adirondack chairs for four provide a relaxing spot for morning coffee, while two large ceiling fans keep the porch comfortable throughout the day. French doors open directly into the home's inviting living spaces. A white picket fence surrounds the front yard, with convenient bike parking for up to six bikes just inside the entrance. Along the side of the home, a shaded brick courtyard provides another inviting outdoor gathering space. The courtyard features outdoor dining for four, a bench swing, charcoal grill, and outdoor shower—ideal for rinsing off after a day at the beach and enjoying dinner outdoors.Bright Living Spaces & Renovated KitchenInside, Lemon Tree features an open and comfortable common living area designed for relaxing and gathering after a day exploring Seaside. The central living room includes a comfortable sofa and three club chairs, providing plenty of seating for family and friends. A large flat-screen TV with a Sonos soundbar creates an ideal setup for movie nights or relaxing indoors. Adjacent to the living room, the dining area seats four, while a central breakfast bar provides seating for four additional guests.The renovated kitchen combines style and functionality with quartz countertops, new stainless-steel appliances, a four-burner electric cooktop, large double-door refrigerator, microwave, Keurig, traditional coffee maker, toaster, and a well-equipped collection of dishes, cookware, and kitchen essentials. Custom cabinetry provides generous storage, making it easy to settle in and prepare everything from quick breakfasts before the beach to family dinners at home. A convenient half bathroom is located just off the main living area.Four Bedrooms Across Two FloorsWith four bedrooms spread across two levels, Lemon Tree offers a flexible sleeping arrangement for families and groups traveling together. The first-floor king bedroom is located just off the living room and features two closets, large nightstands, and a mounted flat-screen TV. Its renovated ensuite bathroom includes a quartz vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower with both a rain showerhead and handheld wand. The second first-floor bedroom features a mounted flat-screen TV, blackout shades, and a renovated ensuite bathroom accessed through a barn-style door. The bathroom includes a quartz vanity, custom shelving, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Upstairs, the third bedroom features a comfortable queen bed, dual nightstands, a dresser, and a large mounted flat-screen TV. Down the hall, the custom-built bunk room is designed with families in mind and features two queen beds, providing sleeping space for four guests. Each bunk has built-in storage underneath, individual lighting, and its own mounted flat-screen TV. The bunk room also includes an ensuite full bathroom with dual vanities and a tub/shower combination.Walk to Seaside Town Square, Shops & RestaurantsLemon Tree's central location makes it easy to experience the best of Seaside without getting in the car. Seaside Town Square and more than 40 shops and restaurants are just a short walk from the home, putting dining, shopping, coffee, entertainment, and the beach all within easy reach. Spend the afternoon browsing local boutiques, enjoy a meal at one of Seaside's restaurants, or simply stroll through the pedestrian-friendly streets and take in the relaxed atmosphere of this iconic coastal community. With the beach just approximately a 3-minute walk away and Town Square nearby, Lemon Tree is an ideal walkable Seaside vacation rental for families and groups.* 5 night minimum for Spring, Spring Break, and Summer; 3 nights Fall; 2 nights minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.Features:1,664 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space179 yards or a 3 minute walk to private residential Seaside beach access at West Ruskin PavilionSeaside is the largest private beach on 30AKeurig and coffee pot for convenienceOutdoor showerOutdoor charcoal grillBike parking for six bikes inside courtyardWasher and dryerAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued. (a golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited—special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit)No pets allowed
